learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain selected learning theories and distinguish them from each other. They are also able to reasonably highlight application contexts from the different theories.
Students have diagnostic knowledge and discuss it in the context of pedagogical action, considering empirical findings.

Students are able to demonstrate the importance of competence orientation for the vocational education system and assess its consequences, especially for the design of competence-oriented examinations.

Students know learning-relevant teaching characteristics and can reflect on their importance against the background of their own learning biographical experiences. They are able to design effective learning environments, plan and conduct appropriate examination forms.

Students have a critical understanding of the aspects of diversity, individuality, and heterogeneity in learning groups and, in this context, possess basic knowledge for the individual support of learners and their learning processes.

syllabus_topics: Diversity, individuality and heterogeneity in learning groups, individual support
Research methodological foundations of educational psychology, observation and assessment instruments, observation and assessment errors
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
